description: This file defines the EventHubSequenceToken class which represents a token for a specific position within an Azure Event Hub partition, including offset, sequence number, and event index, used for stream processing with Orleans.

classes.name: EventHubSequenceToken
classes.description: A serializable class representing a sequence token within an Event Hub, including offset, sequence number, and event index for ordered processing.

methods.name: EventHubSequenceToken(string eventHubOffset, long sequenceNumber, int eventIndex)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the token with offset, sequence number, and event index.

methods.name: ToString()
methods.description: Returns a formatted string description of the token.
